headline: Hira Norm adds 5.56 points to reach 41st on ARC-2

sections.text: Hira Norm gained 5.56 points to reach 41.39, moving from 63rd to 41st on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The rise extends Norm’s move into the top 100 reported yesterday. The gold cutoff is 58.06 at 15th.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
